_comment: W-50 HARNESS_24x7 seats config. worktreeGlob is a prefix pattern under D:\ferrum_os.worktrees, not a single fixed path - each seat has many numbered worktrees over time; the harness resolves the most-recently-modified match at revival time. Verified against disk 2026-09-04: atlas/mason/rivet/crane/scribe all have real matching worktrees; ferrite/pi had none observed then, left null rather than invented. Updated 2026-09-08 (W-98 follow-up): PI and FERRITE had genuinely zero worktrees anywhere on disk, which meant the trigger daemon could never dispatch either seat (Resolve-SeatWorktree always returned null) - real worktrees (pi-base on branch pi/base, ferrite-base on branch ferrite/base, both off origin/main) were created and their globs set below, rather than fabricating a path mapping to something that doesn't exist.

deployment._comment: Single source of truth for the live URL (W-64, 2026-09-05). Every seat, the ATLAS battery, and every audit/battery script (via scripts/get-live-base-url.mjs) read from here, not a locally remembered/hardcoded value - the worker was renamed 2026-09-05 (crane/rename-worker-privacy, wrangler.jsonc name field) and the old URL now 404s.
